FAQ

October 2026

If you want to understand lizards, the first thing to notice is that they are not trying to be mammals. Almost every misunderstanding about them comes from judging them by a standard they never signed up for.

A lizard that sits still for an hour is not bored, and it is not lazy. It is saving energy that a mammal would have burned just keeping warm. That single difference explains a surprising amount of what they do, from how they hunt to how long they can go without food.

The second thing to notice is that they are extremely good at what they do. Chameleons tune crystals in their skin. Geckos use van der Waals forces to walk on glass. Basilisks run on water. None of this is primitive; it is just different.

So the practical advice is simple. When a lizard does something that looks strange, assume there is a reason, and go looking for it. You will usually find one, and it will usually be more interesting than whatever you assumed at first.

Thanks to everyone who read drafts of this.
